enchantments.tooltip: Strength +14: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Quality Seeker +3: Provides a +3 Quality bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +3 Quality bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Armor-Piercing 22%: Passive: +22% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Raging Strength 3: Your Rage abilities grant an additional +3 Strength
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
